crossRefs.note: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.

translations.web: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.
translations.bsb: See the strength of his loins and the power in the muscles of his belly.
translations.kjv: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.
translations.asv: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, And his force is in the muscles of his belly.
